reason: Both correctly identified water-cooled condensing as normal, but Conversation 1 gave a fuller, more confident explanation (why vented dryers differ, where the manual mentions it, water usage) and laid out exactly which signs would indicate a real fault - water in the drum, wet clothes, leaks, gushing - matching the expected discriminators. Conversation 2 hedged with 'we need to rule out a blockage' and asked a two-month-old-machine owner to inspect the pump filter, an unnecessary step it then conceded was not needed, and never asked the key questions about the detergent drawer or whether clothes dry. Neither recommended parts or escalation, and there was no safety issue, so Conversation 1 wins on diagnostic clarity and question efficiency.
